patch_description:
The seven-line construction is close to the best possible *antipodal* packing, but its enforced antipodal symmetry prevents it from reaching configurations in which the 14 points can move independently. The reference ratio is above the apparent antipodal-line-packing plateau, so the final candidate should be refined as a general diameter-normalized 14-point packing.

This edit preserves the strong antipodal solution as a guaranteed incumbent, then applies deterministic symmetry-breaking perturbations and direct optimization of all 91 squared pairwise distances. The optimization maximizes a smooth approximation of the log minimum-distance / maximum-distance objective. Centering and RMS normalization remove the translation and scale null directions after each step. Candidates are always selected using the evaluator’s actual unsmoothed squared-distance ratio, so smoothing cannot cause a worse result than the original antipodal construction.
